## What's new

- Box art for homebrew: press X on a game, then Get Box Art or Replace Box Art, and choose where from. Find Automatically works as before; Search itch.io looks through that console's itch.io games, where most new homebrew is published; Use a Screenshot takes one of your own screenshots of the game (MENU + X), such as its title screen. Covers are shown one at a time, large: left and right to look, A to use one.
- Games come first: nothing of ChaOS's own runs while you play. An update that was downloading pauses and picks up where it left off once you're done, with "Downloading ChaOS ... %" on the shelf until it finishes. Muse keeps playing.
- The Box Art row in a game's X menu works without Wi-Fi too, for screenshots.

itch.io's list for a console is read onto the card the first time you search it (a minute or so), then brought up to date once a day. Thanks to NextUI-Itchio-Pak for showing the way.

---

ChaOS 1.2.0 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v1.2.0-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.2.0](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.2.0) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v1.2.0-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
